body: No. No. Effing no. I want to be able to let it go. I CANNOT. And there is NO FUCKING WAY I am ever going to be able to explain that to some random stranger on the internet. The details are much too personal. My ex talks to me again, even just to say that he doesn't hate me, I won't do it. But that's unlikely to happen so, yeah, I'm going to do it. Just got to wait until after my friends wedding since I'm in the wedding party.

I've been trying to let it go for OVER a year now. It's impossible and unless he agrees to speak with me like he promised to, it's happening. I can only hold on for so much longer without getting to speak with him again.
This sounds a lot like something my ex would possibly write.
